en: Black‑and‑white image of a large historicist town‑hall–style building on a square. The structure has steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and a tall central clock tower capped with an onion dome and smaller cupolas. There is a fountain or monument in front of the main façade and a few people visible in the square. Surrounding streets are lined with early 20th‑century European townhouses. No legible caption or writing appears on the front.
